result.text:
This year brought a lot of updates across Fillout and Zite.

As we close out 2025, we want to thank you for trusting us with your forms, workflows and all things no-code.

We’re excited to keep making Fillout and Zite better for you in 2026.

And for now, here's a recap of the biggest launches from this year 👇

🌎 Multi-language form translations

Translate your form into multiple languages with AI. Edit translations if needed.

✨ Introducing Zite (build full-stack apps)

In April we introduced Zite, our AI app builder for creating business apps, internal tools and customer-facing portals.

✅ Quality-of-life improvements in forms

A bunch of quality-of-life improvements shipped this year:

- Bulk field operations (select multiple fields, copy/paste, mark required, set logic)
- Bulk approvals (approve/reject submissions at scale)
- Restore form versions (version history)
- Better collaboration (sharing + invite links, internal notes)
- Organization asset gallery for reusable images/logos

🗄️ Databases, built for Fillout + Zite

We launched Zite’s built-in database to act on your form and app data.

Zite database is as easy to use as a spreadsheet and as scalable as a SQL database. Build with:
- Linked records + dozens of field types
- CSV, Airtable and Google Sheet import/export
- Undo/redo
- REST API + webhooks
- Granular permissions + SOC 2 Type II

🔐 Auth + user login for Zite apps

Zite apps have built-in user and access control.

- Database-first authentication (no duplicate user records)
- Secure backend workflows + observability
- Internal-only, invite-only, or public signups
- No user limits on any tier

🤖 Agentic mode + partial file edits in Zite

Zite got smarter when working in large projects:

- Reads/changes only what’s necessary
- Partial file edits to reduce token burn and speed up iterations
- Better issue detection + automatic fixes
- Faster editor for large apps + chat pagination

💳 New Team Plan + simplified billing

We introduced an all-in-one bundle that brings Fillout Forms, Zite Apps and Databases together with unlimited seats. Plus, a unified billing + usage page to manage everything in one place.

📆 Faster scheduling forms and new integrations

Fillout Scheduling improvements:

- Microsoft Outlook scheduling integration
- Jump straight to the first month with availability
- Up to 12.5× faster scheduling links (biggest gains for multi-attendee + round robin)
- Easier host management + multiple calendar support

🔌 New form integrations and reliability improvements

We added new integrations and improved existing ones:

- n8n integration
- ClickUp integration
- Re-run failed integrations in one click

We'll be kicking off January with a launch week and can't wait to show you what's next.

Happy New Year!

The Fillout Team
